4b - COMPOSITE -> COLMAP DATASET (dual-res: proxies pose it, the 8K frames train it)

Same shape as 2b2. SfM runs on the small proxies -- SPHERE poses are ANGULAR, so posing gains
nothing from 8K, and keeping it small is what makes EXHAUSTIVE matching affordable. The pinhole
cube faces LichtFeld actually trains on are reprojected from the 8K composites, read off disk
one at a time (loading them into a ComfyUI tensor would be ~33 GB).

WIRING
  1. Loader 'directory'  -> <ComfyUI>/output/hires_composite/proxies      (select_every_nth = 1)
  2. hires_dir           -> <ComfyUI>/output/hires_composite/frames
  3. output_name         -> whatever you want the dataset folder called
Both folders hold the SAME frames in the SAME sorted order, because 4a names them
traj00_frame_0000.png, traj01_frame_0000.png, ... -- that is why every trajectory shares one
folder and gets its own traj_index.

MATCHER = exhaustive   matches ALL pairs, so the separate trajectories fuse into ONE model.
                       (sequential only links temporally adjacent frames -> 4 separate rooms.)
ON_SPLIT = stop        if it still forms more than one model the node raises with the
                       per-model breakdown and reprojects nothing, instead of silently
                       training on the biggest fragment.
face_size = 0          auto (~equirect_width/4), so 8192 equirects give 2048px faces.

THEN TRAIN -- and do not leave the cap at its default:
  LichtFeld-Studio.exe -d "<dataset>" -o "<dataset>\splat" --headless --train --no-splash ^
      --eval --test-every 8 -r 1 --max-width 4096 --max-cap 3000000

--max-cap 3000000 is load-bearing. Every run in the research project silently stopped at
LichtFeld's 1M default, which was hiding the resolution gain: 1M -> 3M buys +0.62 dB and
+3.8 render detail. 3M -> 6M buys +0.06 dB for 60% more training time -- not worth it.

WHAT TO EXPECT, AND WHAT NOT TO
Failures land on glass, mirrors and depth silhouettes, because MoGe is accurate to ~2% on
ordinary surfaces and wrong on those. More camera paths will NOT fix that -- every path
reprojects the same depth map, so no camera path fixes a mirror. Extra paths DO buy a larger
explorable volume, which is worth having on its own terms.
